ExecutionLabel.description: Provenance shown in UI, logs and video. Only LIVE counts toward P0 acceptance.
ExecutionLabel.title: ExecutionLabel

FreeBusyResult.description: An `error` result means unavailable. An `ok` result with no busy ranges is the only free signal.
FreeBusyResult.title: FreeBusyResult

GoogleConnectionRef.description: Server-selected connection. Adapters load and refresh tokens themselves; tokens never cross this boundary.
GoogleConnectionRef.title: GoogleConnectionRef

explicit_rejection.description: True only when a documented adapter classifier proves the provider rejected the request before accepting it.
explicit_rejection.title: Explicit Rejection

HealthReady.description: Sanitized readiness summary. Returned as data on 200, and as error.details on 503.
HealthReady.title: HealthReady

Limits.description: P0 single-conversation ceilings. Raising a bound needs a reviewed contract and quota change.
Limits.title: Limits

OutboundEmail.description: Immutable plain-text message built by the server. Exactly one recipient; no Cc/Bcc/Reply-To.
OutboundEmail.title: OutboundEmail

ReconcileResult.description: `unresolved` is inconclusive (indexing lag), never proof that nothing was sent.
ReconcileResult.title: ReconcileResult

estimated_cost.description: Unknown cost is null, never zero.

post.description:
Synchronous bounded ingestion (fetch <=10 s / 1 MB). Returns the new untrusted evidence; never approves facts.
A replay of the same key and body returns 200 with the original evidence.
